description: The Challenge, presented by Gainesway, looks at how the Breeders' Cup Turf (G1T) division is shaping up ahead of the Christophe Clement Turf Stakes (G1T).

title_en: Sweet Azteca Weighs In for Rancho Bernardo Repeat
description: Sweet Azteca does not race often, but when she does look out. The massive gray/roan mare tops the field for the Rancho Bernardo Stakes (G3) Aug. 16 at Del Mar, with a start in the Breeders' Cup on the horizon.

title_en: HIWU Alleges Banned Substance Finding Against Quiroz
description: HIWU alleges trainer Angel Quiroz, who trains some horses being investigated following dramatic improvement in races with questionable betting patterns, had a Fair Hill-based runner, Bonita Rough, test positive in a sample taken July 10.

title_en: Gas Me Up Looks for Back-to-Back Wins in King Edward
description: Last year's King Edward Stakes (G2T) winner Gas Me Up will look for his second consecutive win in the $200,000 1-mile race Aug. 15 at Woodbine, where he will face a field of five.

title_en: Grade 1 Winner Seismic Beauty Retired From Racing
description: Seismic Beauty, winner of the 2025 Clement L. Hirsch Stakes (G1), has been retired from racing, according to Boyd Racing racing manager Brittany Linton.

title_en: Gulfstream Park Decoupling Effort Dealt Court Setback
description: A Florida state court judge dismissed a lawsuit brought by Gulfstream Park that sought to allow decoupling of its Thoroughbred racing program from it operation of slot machines.

title_en: Fairmount Park Expects Heat, Cancels Aug. 15 Card
description: Live racing at Fairmount Park has been canceled for Aug. 15 because of forecasted extreme temperatures. Racing will resume Aug. 18.

title_en: Martin to Retire From ARCI President Role
description: The Association of Racing Commissioners International board has been informed by its president Ed Martin that this will be his last year as a full-time employee of the association.

title_en: TAA Hosts First Equine Assisted Services Summit
description: Thoroughbred Aftercare Alliance hosted its first Equine Assisted Services Summit Aug. 12 in Saratoga Springs, N.Y., bringing together professionals and organizations from across the aftercare community specializing in equine-assisted services.

title_en: East Avenue, Chunk of Gold Clash Again in Iselin
description: Chunk of Gold has finished ahead of East Avenue in two of three previous meetings, including a win in the 2025 West Virginia Derby (G3).

title_en: Tattersalls Attracts Three Related to Gstaad, Vandeek
description: Maywood Stud will present three immediate relatives of group 1-winning siblings Vandeek and Gstaad at Tattersalls later this year, two immediate relatives in the October sale and a Wootton Bassett half sister in the December Foal Sale lineup.

title_en: Outfielder Returns to States in Mahony
description: After an unsuccessful trip to Royal Ascot in June, sophomore turf sprinter Outfielder is back in America and ready to reassert himself atop the division in the $225,000 Mahony Stakes (G3T) Aug. 16 at Saratoga Race Course.

title_en: Goffs Strengthens U.S. Presence With Addition of Dubois
description: Louis Dubois will work alongside existing United States representative Jacob West, with Tom Taaffe continuing to focus on the American market as part of his international client relations role.

title_en: Five Supplements Join Book 1 of Keeneland Sept. Sale
description: Keeneland announces that five horses—sons of Into Mischief, Vekoma, and Yaupon, and two colts from the final crop of Uncle Mo—have been supplemented to Book 1 of the Keeneland September Yearling Sale Sept. 14-15.

title_en: Del Mar Offers $2.1 Million in Fall Meet Stakes
description: Headlined by a pair of grade 1 stakes offerings, Del Mar will present a $2.1 million stakes schedule during its 13th Bing Crosby Season Nov. 6-29.

title_en: WA Native Ward Ships Touchy West for Longacres Mile
description: In four decades as a jockey and trainer, Wesley Ward has won just about everything in racing except the Longacres Mile. That could change, however, when Ward sends out highly regarded Touchy in the Aug. 16 race at Emerald Downs.

title_en: Sovereignty Now Tied for Sixth in Latest World Rankings
description: With his 4 3/4-length victory in the Aug. 8 Whitney Stakes (G1) at Saratoga, reigning Horse of the Year Sovereignty has ascended within the Longines World's Best Racehorse Rankings, tied with four other horses in sixth place with a 125 rating.

title_en: BHM Rewind: Maryland Gov. Moore on Triple Crown Changes
description: In this clip from the Aug. 10 episode of BloodHorse Monday: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore shares his thoughts with co-host Louie Rabaut on moving the Preakness Stakes (G1) to the fourth Sunday of May and the overall impact it has on the Triple Crown.

title_en: Ellis Park Adjusts Weekend Schedule Due to Heat
description: Ellis Park's live racing schedule will be adjusted this weekend because of forecast heat index values of up to 109 degrees in the Henderson, Ky., area.

title_en: British Betting Coup Tied to Fair Hill Controversy
description: A six-figure betting coup was pulled off in betting shops in Britain Aug. 9 after four out of five horses from the same training center won in the United States.

title_en: Remington Park Thoroughbred Meet Begins Aug. 21
description: The thoroughbred season at Remington Park opens Aug. 21, launching a season of 62 race dates that include Oklahoma Derby Week festivities, Oklahoma Classics, and the return of Extreme Holiday Showdown.

title_en: Trainers Rufino, Simpson Receive Lengthy Suspensions
description: Trainers Eusebio Juarez Rufino and Shannon Simpson have received lengthy suspensions and prohibitive fines in resolutions posted this week to the Horseracing Integrity and Welfare Unit website.

title_en: Success of CAW Guardrails at Saratoga Garners Attention
description: A passionate panel discussion considering if the casual bettor, consistent bettor, and computer-assisted wagering bettor can coexist points to the difficult spot in which the industry finds itself after years of helping facilitate CAW handle growth.

title_en: Tawny Port a Sentimental Favorite in Christophe Clement
description: There's no doubt who will be the sentimental favorite in the Aug. 15 Christophe Clement Turf Stakes (G1T). That will be Peachtree Stable's Tawny Port, who is trained by Miguel Clement, the son of the late Christophe Clement.

title_en: Manitoba-Bred Brachetto Could Make Plate History
description: No Manitoba-bred racehorse has ever won the King's Plate. That could change Aug. 15 at Woodbine in the 167th running of the first jewel of the Canadian Triple Crown.

description: The Thoroughbred Owners and Breeders Association will celebrate state and Canadian winners at a Sept. 11 luncheon at Coolmore's Ashford Stud near Versailles, Ky.

description: Four-time grade 1-winning turf horse Deterministic will enter stud at Lane's End in Kentucky following the conclusion of his racing career.
